analysis.title: GS Sharkey - US Equities Mid Day Color 20 Nov 2026
key_insights: Risk-off tape at 1:38pm ET on 11/20: RTY > SPX > NDX, VIX ticking with a 30-handle, GS Panic Index 9/10. 60% of SPX names are red, and 464 names closed down on 11/19.
Financial conditions continue to tighten (GSUSFCI) despite a 10bp pullback in rates.
Tech under pressure: GS AI basket -6.5%, Semis -7.6%, Software -1.2%, NVDA -6.8% and lower in 9 of the past 10 sessions.
Investors had hoped ECM activity would act as a clearing event to start a risk-back-on trade into year end. Without it the tape has been hard to hold.
Flight to safety: Cyclicals vs Defensives basket -2.8%, staples +1.6%, utilities +1.2%.
Retail risk-off: Retail Favorites basket -6.6%, Bitcoin Sensitive basket -7%.
CTAs sold $57bn over the past month and are estimated at US net short -$19bn. Next-week modeled selling: $65.8bn in a flat tape, $28.6bn in an up tape, $80.6bn in a down tape.

Liquidity is thin: S&P top-of-book liquidity at $1.5mm, the lowest since Liberation Day. ETF volume is 39% of the tape vs 28% YTD average, the highest since March. Option expiry is lifting volumes, and closing volumes are expected to be elevated.

GS desk flows: activity 6/10, franchise flows skewed 1% better for sale. Long-only clients skew 3% better to buy (macro products, real estate, financials). Hedge funds skew 1.5% better to buy (energy, healthcare, financials).
SPX is on track for a 7th consecutive lower close, which has happened only a handful of times in the past few decades.
